question: In India, the Young Men’s Christian Association (YMCA) at ___________ introduced basketball for the first time.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The Young Men's Christian Association (YMCA) introduced basketball in India for the first time at **Kolkata**.

• The YMCA is a worldwide organization that promotes physical, social, and spiritual well-being.

• Basketball was first introduced in India in the early 20th century.

• Kolkata was one of the major centers for sports and physical education during the British colonial period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Young Men's Christian Association (YMCA)**

• Founded on June 6, 1844, in London, England by Sir George Williams.

• YMCA aims to put Christian principles into practice by promoting a healthy mind, body, and spirit.

• It operates in 120 countries, including India, and has over 64 million beneficiaries globally.

• YMCA activities include sports, physical education, community development, and youth programs.

• **Basketball**

• Basketball is a team sport in which two teams, most commonly of five players each, opposing one another on a rectangular court, compete with the primary objective of shooting a basketball through the defender's hoop.

• The game was invented by Dr. James Naismith in December 1891 in Springfield, Massachusetts, USA.

• It is one of the world's most popular and widely viewed sports.

• Basketball is played by millions of people worldwide, both as a casual and competitive sport.

• **Kolkata (formerly Calcutta)**

• Kolkata is the capital of the Indian state of West Bengal.

• It was the capital of British India from 1772 to 1911.

• Kolkata is known for its cultural, commercial, and educational institutions.

• The city has a rich history in sports, being home to major sports clubs and hosting numerous sports events.
